mapper.select: select id, shop_id, user_id, product_id, quantity, name, image, price, description, insurance_detail, insurance_fee, created_at, updated_at from cart where user_id = #{userId} and shop_id = #{shopId} order by created_at desc, id desc

select id, shop_id, user_id, product_id, quantity, name, image, price, description, insurance_detail, insurance_fee, created_at, updated_at from cart where user_id = #{userId} and product_id = #{productId} and shop_id = #{shopId}
mapper.insert: insert into cart (shop_id, user_id, product_id, quantity, name, image, price, description, insurance_detail, insurance_fee, created_at) values (#{shopId}, #{userId}, #{productId}, #{quantity}, #{name}, #{image}, #{price}, #{description}, #{insuranceDetail}, #{insuranceFee}, now())
mapper.update: update cart set quantity = #{quantity}, name = #{name}, image = #{image}, price = #{price}, description = #{description}, insurance_detail = #{insuranceDetail}, insurance_fee = #{insuranceFee}, updated_at = now() where id = #{id} and shop_id = #{shopId}
mapper.delete: delete from cart where user_id = #{userId} and product_id = #{productId} and shop_id = #{shopId}
delete from cart where user_id = #{userId} and shop_id = #{shopId}
